Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-011 - Locale-stable currency, compact amount, and date formatting

parameters.script: const results=[]; for(let page=1; page<=5; page++){ const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).map(r=>r.innerText); results.push({page,href:location.href,rows:rows.length,has18Aug:rows.some(r=>r.includes('18 Aug 2026')),dates:rows.map(r=>r.split('\n').slice(-3,-1)[0])}); const next=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Next page'); if(!next || next.disabled) break; next.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); } return {pages:results, finalFooter:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0])};

const prev=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Previous page'); if(prev && !prev.disabled){prev.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));} const matches=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).filter(r=>r.innerText.includes('18 Aug 2026')).map(r=>({text:r.innerText,href:r.querySelector('a')?.href||r.closest('a')?.href||null})); return {href:location.href,footer:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]),matches};

const next=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Next page'&&!b.disabled); if(next){next.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));} const matches=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).filter(r=>r.innerText.includes('18 Aug 2026')).map(r=>({text:r.innerText,html:r.outerHTML.slice(0,1200),rect:r.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON()})); return {href:location.href,footer:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]),matches};

const prev=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Previous page'&&!b.disabled); if(prev){prev.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));} const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).filter(r=>r.innerText.includes('18 Aug 2026')); return {href:location.href,footer:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]),rows:rows.map(r=>({text:r.innerText,html:r.outerHTML.slice(0,2200),role:r.getAttribute('role'),tabindex:r.getAttribute('tabindex')}))};

const text=document.body.innerText; const has18=text.includes('18 Aug 2026'); const next=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Next page'&&!b.disabled); if(!has18 && next){next.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));} const row=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).find(r=>r.innerText.includes('18 Aug 2026')&&r.innerText.includes('EFREG002-NoReceipt-EFQA-20260923T1235')); if(!row) return {opened:false,href:location.href,footer:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]),has18:document.body.innerText.includes('18 Aug 2026')}; row.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return {opened:true,href:location.href};

const text=document.body.innerText; return {href:location.href, dateFields:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('dt,dd')).filter(e=>e.innerText.trim()==='Date'||/\d{1,2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} 2026/.test(e.innerText)).map(e=>e.innerText.trim()), hasExpected:text.includes('18 Aug 2026'), timeZone:Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone, locale:Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale, body:text.slice(0,1000)};
